item.title: Kenya Orders Blockchain Tracking for Imported Medicines
item.summary: Kenya’s Ministry of Health has announced a broad regulatory overhaul aimed at curbing counterfeit and substandard medicines, requiring pharmaceutical imports to comply with strict digital identification rules beginning in January. The framework, unveiled during the Kenya Health Summit in Nairobi, requires imported medical products to carry unique serialized digital identifiers.
